id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6ae2: "This country has lots of horses. I stepped in some dung and put my girlfriend in a bad mood.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6aed: "I splurged to take this trip, but nothing goes right. It's just one thing after another. Sigh...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6afc: "I upset my girlfriend somehow... To cheer her up, I pulled every string and got tickets to the hit circus.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6b0b: "But she's still sulking... I worked hard to get those tickets, but nothing goes right. Sigh...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6b1b: "My girlfriend's a fan of Prince Faris. To apologize for upsetting her, I asked her to watch the prince with me...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6b29: "But somehow she sulked even more. It's the Faris Cup, and nothing goes right. Sigh...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6b97: "He's so clumsy! He keeps stepping in horse dung! He's ruining our trip!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6ba2: "I don't want to walk with someone who smells like a horse. If I'm dating, I want a handsome, capable guy like Prince Faris!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6bb5: "It's a special circus, and I don't want to watch with someone clumsy who keeps stepping in dung!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6bc1: "If I'm dating, I want a handsome, capable guy like Prince Faris! I'm done with this smelly man! Hmph!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6bd3: "He's so shameless, suggesting we go watch the prince run... Has he no pride as a man?
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6bde: "If I have to watch with someone this clumsy, I'd rather watch the prince's gallant form alone!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6c51: "And in the lead is Sharukh! A landslide! He may break his own tournament record!

id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6e5a: "...If it comes true, everyone will want to know my method. And I'll profit too... Heh heh.

id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6fb7: "As the Faris Cup nears, his passion for horses grows even stronger. It's honestly stifling.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|70a8: "By Gallopolis custom, royals enter a horse race at 16. This is the year Prince Faris enters!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|70b7: "Prince Faris, called the finest prince since Gallopolis's founding, must be very fast in races too!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|70c9: "I saw knights heading toward the west Race House! The Faris Cup is finally starting!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|70d4: "I wonder what kind of ride Prince Faris, called the finest prince since Gallopolis's founding, will show in the race!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|71e0: "The Faris Cup at last. It reminds me of the current Sultan's first race at sixteen.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|71ed: "Seeing the young Sultan's brave ride then, I felt the country would be safe as long as he ruled.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|725c: "The world's all excited over races and circuses, but decades ago monsters caused tragedies everywhere.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|726b: "Now monsters have weakened, and life is much easier than before. What a blessing...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|72d2: "Oh, traveler. Do you know the desert killer?
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|72db: "I see. Every year at this time it appears... Be very careful when you go outside.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|72ea: "Better not to know. But if you value your life, it's wise to stay away from the Celestial Sands to the north.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|72fd: "The Faris Cup again already... I look forward to the prince's ride, but worry the desert killer may appear again.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|737a: "I like strong people! I came to see the prince, Gallopolis's treasure, run in the Faris Cup.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7387: "They say Prince Faris is strong, sturdy and a very refreshing handsome man. He must be fast in races too.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7453: "Anyone who can handle a horse seems qualified to enter the horse races.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|745c: "But the coming Faris Cup is different. Only chosen people, like the prince, can enter that race.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7508: "This is the racetrack, where people chasing romance come to seek their dreams.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7520: "This is the racetrack, where people chasing romance come to seek their dreams.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7539: "This is the racetrack, where people chasing romance come to seek their dreams.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7511: "If you wish to enter a race, apply at the reception inside.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|758c: "The prince will definitely win the coming Faris Cup! My intuition says so!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7597: "I'm no braggart, but I've watched races all my life. The prince wins! No doubt about it!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|75a7: "What! I won't give up this spot! I've held it for ages! Find another!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|76bd: "The condition of knights and horses just before a race matters. Pairs who communicate well are strong in races too.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|76ca: "...But I can't see Faiz and Sharukh anywhere. What happened? I have a bad feeling.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a84: "I hear the desert killer appeared at the Celestial Sands.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b10: "The folks at the Celestial Sands checkpoint must be in an uproar. This checkpoint is peaceful, thank goodness.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1bf0: "...Oops, more importantly, passing here needs the Sultan of Gallopolis's permission. Go away quietly.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d20: "Beyond here is Laguna di Gondolia. No one without the Sultan of Gallopolis's permission may pass.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1dec: "If you want to pass, show proof you have the Sultan's permission. Do you have anything?
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1eec: "Then I can't let you through. Come back when you have proof of the Sultan's permission.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|204c:
{var:1} showed the Gallopolis letter
to the soldier.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|20b4: "Oh, that's the Sultan of Gallopolis's letter! If you have the Sultan's permission, I must let you through!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2170: "Past this checkpoint is Laguna di Gondolia, a rich land wrapped in water and green.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2224: "Follow the road and you'll reach Gondolia, one of the world's great trading cities. Take care.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2358: "Past this checkpoint is Laguna di Gondolia. Follow the road to reach Gondolia, one of the world's great trading cities.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2454: "Laguna di Gondolia is a green land with lots of rain. Monsters change when it rains, so be careful.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3008: "The desert killer has appeared again... What I feared has finally happened.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3084: "Even I, confident in my skill, ran from the desert killer. Nobody will want to fight it.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|31ac: "Prince Faris's party has entered the Celestial Sands.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3228: "To try to capture the desert killer at his age, how brave. I could never do that.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3334: "Did you hear? The prince captured that Deathscorpion.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3398: "Now there's no need to fear the desert killer. As expected of Prince Faris.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3480: "I heard Prince Faris, rumored to be brilliant, was actually a complete dud.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3518: "Only some soldiers knew, and fooling the people so long is respectable in a way.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3ef0: "You're going to Gondolia! I'm so envious!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3f50: "Laguna di Gondolia is nothing like Gallopolis, a green place with rain. The difference will surprise you.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4038: "A merchant with a rainbow-shining branch passed here a while ago. He must have headed to Gondolia.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4150: "A merchant with a rainbow-shining branch passed here a while ago. He surely headed to Gondolia.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|60c4: "Hey, it's terrible! The desert killer appeared!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6134: "The soldier working here was attacked on patrol at the Celestial Sands and taken to the castle.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|61f8: "Luckily he seems alive. But thinking it could have been me gives me goosebumps... Brr.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|62f8: "I-I can't believe it... A young prince actually captured the desert killer...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|63fc: "Oh, you're the party that beat the desert killer! The rumor has reached even this checkpoint.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|64d0: "With the desert killer gone, this area is safer than before. Thanks to you.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7024: "I'm a scholar from Sniflheim. With the Sultan's permission, I'm surveying this group of ruins.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|710c: "The stars are easy to see in this desert. I think an ancient sage built these ruins for star rituals.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7268: "A chariot carrying a giant scorpion headed back toward the castle...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|72f8: "To capture such a monster... As expected of the prince of the land of knights. Admirable.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|73fc: "Hmm, this ruins layout seems deeply meaningful, but maybe it means nothing...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|74a4: "Ah, for what purpose did the ancient sage build this structure? The mystery only deepens.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8238: "The desert killer beat me. Returning without a scratch on it is truly shameful for a kingdom knight.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8310: "Its claws are strong enough to smash rock. I hear the prince is going to capture it, but is it really okay...? Ow.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8450: "Getting beaten by the desert killer let me befriend this kitty. A blessing in disguise.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8504: "And it turns out we both liked the same cat, Princess Furris. Maybe it's fate. Ha ha!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b9a0: "From now on, as Sylvando taught me, I'll never forget chivalry and strive to become a fine knight.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ba7c: "Oh, and the monster bell I gave you, feel free to use it as much as you like!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|bb28: "...If you're ever in trouble, come to Gallopolis anytime. I'll be your strength!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|bc10: "Hello, {var:1}. I train every day to become a fine prince of the land of knights.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|bcd4: "I'm still green, but someday I'll be able to defeat the desert killer on my own.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|be9c: "I'm still green, but someday I'll be able to defeat the desert killer on my own.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|bddc: "...Since then, I've trained every day to become a fine prince of the land of knights.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|dc38: "Faris, who showed a gallant ride, will surely capture the desert killer! Our country's future is bright! Ha ha ha!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ddd4: "Traveler, we owe you for everything this time. Faris and we ourselves deeply regret our actions.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|debc: "The merchant who sold the Rainbough said he'd head west to Gondolia. With my letter you can pass the west checkpoint.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e2f4: "The merchant who sold the Rainbough said he'd head west to Gondolia. With my letter you can pass the west checkpoint.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|dff0: "...And if you meet that entertainer on your journey, please thank him for us.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e0b0: "He had the true spirit of chivalry. Seeing him, I felt I recalled something important I'd nearly forgotten.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e23c: "Oh, it's you. You helped with everything the other day. We can't thank you enough.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e428: "...Oh, since you're here, do see Faris at the training grounds. He'll surely be glad to see you.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e57c: "Oh, it's you. You helped us once. ...Hm, you got the Rainbough. Seems your journey is going well, good.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e68c: "The Rainbough was once our nation's treasure, but now it's yours. Use it as you like.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e768: "When you tire of travel, come to our country. Races and the circus will soothe you. Rest is needed sometimes.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e8d4: "The Rainbough was once our nation's treasure, but now it's yours. Use it as you like.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e9a8: "When you tire of travel, come to our country. Races and the circus will soothe you. Rest is needed sometimes.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1029: "Faris not only shone in the race but even set out to capture a monster. What a brave boy!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1035: "I can already picture Faris returning here in high spirits with the captured monster...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1046: "We were so smitten with Faris that we couldn't see his true self. We kept hurting him...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1052: "We deeply regret it. We're grateful to you all and to Sylvando for making us realize.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1064: "Oh, {var:1}. Thank you so much for what you did before.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|106a: "...Since then we've reflected deeply and decided not to spoil Faris anymore.
